info.title: Inauviet ERP API
info.description: Orders, delivery trips and payments. Every error has the shape { statusCode, code, message, details? }. Sign in with POST /auth/login: the session is kept in the HttpOnly cookie erp_session. Each endpoint lists the permission it needs (e.g. orders.create); 403 PERMISSION_DENIED names what is missing.

isAdmin.description: Member of the built-in admin group (every permission)

mustChangePassword.description: The account must set a new password before using the app

newPassword.description: At least 8 characters, must not contain the username

hasPassword.description: No password yet: cannot sign in until one is set

username.description: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore. Stored in lowercase.

password.description: Initial password. Leave empty to generate a temporary one (shown once in the response).

temporaryPassword.description: Only when the server generated the password. Shown once; give it to the person.

username.description: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore. Stored in lowercase.

password.description: Initial password. Leave empty to generate a temporary one (shown once in the response).

isActive.description: false = locked: cannot sign in, current sessions end immediately

password.description: New password. Leave empty to generate a temporary one. The account must change it at next sign-in.

implies.description: Permissions automatically granted with this one

permissions.description: For the built-in admin group this is every permission

isSystem.description: Built-in admin group: cannot be edited or deleted

permissions.description: Permission keys. Unknown keys are ignored; implied ones are added.

openOrderCount.description: Orders that are not completed or cancelled

totalVnd.description: Sum of order totals (priced orders, not cancelled)

taxCode.description: Mã số thuế, for VAT invoices
Mã số thuế, for VAT invoices

pricingMode.description: AREA: price per m², each line has a size. UNIT: price per unit.

category.description: Decal, Bạt, Biển & hộp đèn, Standee, Ấn phẩm…

unit.description: UNIT products only (cái, bộ, hộp…). AREA products always use m².

unitPriceVnd.description: List price in đồng, per m² or per unit

pricingMode.description: AREA: price per m², each line has a size. UNIT: price per unit.

category.description: Decal, Bạt, Biển & hộp đèn, Standee, Ấn phẩm…

unit.description: UNIT products only (cái, bộ, hộp…). AREA products always use m².

unitPriceVnd.description: List price in đồng, per m² or per unit

isExpired.description: Still DRAFT or SENT after validUntil

counts.description: Per status, for the same search (ignores the status filter)

areaM2.description: width × height × quantity, AREA lines only

areaPriceVnd.description: Price per m², AREA lines only

isExpired.description: Still DRAFT or SENT after validUntil

userName.description: Staff member who made the change; null for system changes

productId.description: Catalog product; leave empty for a free-text line

unitPriceVnd.description: Per m² for products priced per m², otherwise per unit. Defaults to the catalog price.

reason.description: Why the customer did not order

sentCount.description: Of which already sent to the customer

isOverdue.description: Open order past its due date

summary.description: Short description of the lines, e.g. "Banner hiflex 2×1 m, Decal PP 30×40 cm"

unplannedQty.description: Total quantity not yet planned for delivery, across all lines

fullyDelivered.description: Every line delivered in full: waiting for the signed acceptance report

quote.description: Quote the order was closed from

quotes.description: Step 1: open quotes (DRAFT, SENT); null without quotes.view

completedDays.description: Completed orders are shown for this many days

unitPriceVnd.description: Optional unit price in đồng (price of one piece for lines priced per m²)

productId.description: Catalog product. With a product priced per m², send widthM/heightM: the piece price is computed on the server.

areaPriceVnd.description: Price per m² for catalog products priced per m² (defaults to the stored or catalog price)

deliveries.description: Delivery plan: one or more trips. Can also be added later.

deposit.description: Optional deposit received with the order

kind.description: CHANGED: product, size, quantity or price differs; ADDED: not on the quote; REMOVED: on the quote, dropped from the order

fromDescription.description: Quote name, when the product or size changed

changes.description: What changed between the quote and the order (step 2: chốt báo giá)

description.description: Name shown everywhere, with the size for lines priced per m² ("Decal PP 1,2×0,8 m")

baseName.description: description without the size: send this back as `description` when editing a line priced per m²

areaPriceVnd.description: Price per m² for lines priced per m²

plannedQty.description: Planned on scheduled trips plus already delivered

deliveredQty.description: Set once the trip is delivered

valueVnd.description: Value of the goods on this trip (delivered qty once delivered); null without prices

code.description: LSX-2610-0014; null for orders started before work orders existed

quote.description: Quote this order was closed from; null for orders entered directly

balanceVnd.description: totalVnd - paidVnd; null when the order has no prices

needsDesign.description: Chosen at step 2: true = design steps 3–4, false = customer files go straight to production

fullyDelivered.description: Every line delivered in full: the acceptance report can be signed

unitPriceVnd.description: Optional unit price in đồng (price of one piece for lines priced per m²)

productId.description: Catalog product. With a product priced per m², send widthM/heightM: the piece price is computed on the server.

areaPriceVnd.description: Price per m² for catalog products priced per m² (defaults to the stored or catalog price)

id.description: Existing line id; omit for a new line

lines.description: The complete new list. Lines left out are removed (only allowed if they have no deliveries).

state.description: TODO: chưa gửi, WAITING: chờ khách, CHANGES: cần sửa, FINAL: đã duyệt / hoàn thiện

lastVersion.description: Latest version sent, null when none yet

note.description: What was sent and how, e.g. "Gửi maket qua Zalo"

approved.description: true: customer approved this version (step 4); false: customer asked for changes

channel.description: How the customer approved: Zalo, Email, Trực tiếp… (approval only, default Zalo)

approvedByName.description: Who approved on the customer side (approval only, default the customer name)

finalized.description: Print files are finished from the approved version (needed before locking)

source.description: What the workshop prints from: "File khách gửi" or "Maket v2 đã duyệt"

stage.description: Move to this stage; omitted = the next one

signedBy.description: Who signed on the customer side

valueVnd.description: Value of the goods on this trip (delivered qty once delivered); null without prices

deliveredQty.description: 0 up to the planned quantity. Anything less than planned returns to "not yet planned".

lines.description: Omit to deliver exactly what was planned

payment.description: Money collected on this trip; recorded as a payment linked to it

sumVnd.description: Sum of the matching payments that are not voided

delivered.description: At least one trip delivered: money is due now

firstDeliveredAt.description: Date of the first delivered trip

upcomingBalanceVnd.description: Balance of orders not delivered yet

depositsHeldVnd.description: Money received on open orders with nothing delivered yet (deposits held)

deliveryId.description: The trip this money was collected on (must belong to the same order)

sourceId.description: Quote id for kind "quote", order id otherwise

key.description: Order id, or quote id when the quote never became an order

title.description: Quote title, or the order's first lines

zipName.description: Name of the zip with every document

revenueVnd.description: Saved at closing, or worked out so far for an open month

previousOpen.description: An earlier month is still open: steps and closing wait for it

isFirst.description: First month of the books: openings can be edited

month.description: First month kept in the books, e.g. "2026-10"

summary.description: What the step will post or posted, e.g. "Khấu hao 4.250.000 đ · 4 tài sản"

pendingIssues.description: Orders in production or later with no materials issued yet

originalLines.description: Lines as first posted, for an automatic entry changed by hand

canEdit.description: Open month, not a month-end entry

trialBalance.description: Bảng cân đối số phát sinh: debit-positive balances

priceVnd.description: Weighted average once priced, provisional price before

chargedVnd.description: Charged through the selected month (this month counted once its step ran)

usedAccounts.description: Accounts with an opening balance or a movement this month

differenceVnd.description: Σ debit − Σ credit: must be 0

orderId.description: The order the materials go to (its work order)

categoryId.description: An expense: its category (exactly one of categoryId / supplierId)

supplierId.description: A payment to a supplier for what was bought on credit

amountVnd.description: Amount before VAT (the whole amount for a supplier payment)

vatRate.description: VAT on an expense invoice; 0 when there is none

purchase.description: Bought now: posts Dr 211 / 242 (+ 1331), Cr cash, bank or 331. Omitted: owned before the books started.

reason.description: Required when changing an automatic entry
